name: Hand-Drawn Hardship Cartoon
description: An expressive figurative illustration language using uneven ink, limited flat color, and sparse annotated paper-like space.
style_bible: Draw with uneven black ink contours, flat limited fills, and sparse paper-like backgrounds. Where figures appear, keep them anatomically coherent and expressive, with clear eyes, limbs and posture; where an animal appears, keep its species-defining features readable. Use a tactile hand-drawn annotation texture only where the selected thumbnail recipe asks for it; keep one readable focal subject and avoid crowding the frame. Favor warm moss, muted leaf green, cream, charcoal, faded gold, and quiet earth tones over glossy dramatic lighting.
negative_prompt: Reject photoreal stock imagery, glossy CGI, copied channel branding, duplicate captions, watermarks/logos, violent cruelty, malformed anatomy, malformed text, dense collage, cluttered labels, neon colors, and copied trade dress.
